name: Makurdi–Guma Rural Feeder Roads (Phase 1)
summary: Rehabilitation of 38km of farm-to-market feeder roads reconnecting displaced farming communities in Guma LGA to Makurdi markets.

name: Daudu Community Resettlement Scheme
summary: Reconstruction of housing, water points and a primary school for families displaced by farmer-herder conflict, with reintegration support.

name: Lokoja Riverbank Flood-Resilience Works
summary: Embankment reinforcement and drainage upgrades in flood-prone confluence communities of Lokoja.

name: Community Mining Cooperatives Pilot
summary: Pilot programme formalising artisanal miners into cooperatives with safety training and equipment support, with the Federal Ministry of Solid Minerals.

name: North Central Innovation Hub, Ilorin
summary: A regional digital-skills and enterprise hub with training capacity for 2,000 young people annually.

name: Agribusiness Incubation Centre, Shonga
summary: Incubation centre supporting rice and cassava value-chain startups in the Shonga farming belt.

name: NCDC Headquarters Complex, Lafia
summary: Office complex donated by the Nasarawa State Government, refurbished as the Commission's national headquarters.

name: Lithium Value-Chain Development Study
summary: Feasibility and community-benefit framework for lithium beneficiation in the Nasarawa mineral belt.

name: Shiroro Communities Rehabilitation Programme
summary: Phased reconstruction of homes, clinics and schools in communities recovering from banditry, with peacebuilding support.

name: Kainji Dam-Community Irrigation Scheme
summary: Dry-season irrigation infrastructure for dam-host farming communities around Kainji.

name: Barkin Ladi Resettlement & Reconstruction
summary: Rebuilding houses and business premises for displaced highland communities, with reintegration and livelihoods support.

name: Highland Potato Value-Chain Programme
summary: Cold storage, seed multiplication and market access for Plateau's potato belt.

name: Satellite Towns Primary Healthcare Upgrade
summary: Rehabilitation and equipping of primary healthcare centres across FCT area councils, coordinated with the FCT Administration.

name: Regional Schools Rehabilitation (Phase 1)
summary: First phase of classroom reconstruction across conflict-affected LGAs in Benue, Plateau and Niger.

name: Regional Gully-Erosion & Flood Audit
summary: Zone-wide technical audit mapping priority erosion and flood-intervention sites — the evidence base for the Commission's ecology pipeline.

name: North Central Regional Stakeholders Development Summit
summary: Maiden regional summit unveiling the Commission's Strategic Development Roadmap to state governments, traditional institutions and development partners.
